title: 扩散模型微调中LoRA秩的权衡研究
summary: 该研究在CIFAR-10上系统比较了DDPM U-Net不同LoRA秩（2至32）的效果，发现中等秩最有效率：秩4取得最佳FID（124.1380），秩8接近，更高秩收益有限但成本更高，支持小到中等秩作为固定训练预算下的实用默认值。
summary_en: This study systematically compares LoRA ranks (2-32) for DDPM U-Net fine-tuning on CIFAR-10, finding moderate ranks most efficient: rank 4 achieves the best FID (124.1380), rank 8 is close, and higher ranks yield limited gains at greater cost, supporting small-to-moderate ranks as practical defaults under fixed training budgets.
